method: Intact source mask tilts as a rigid face; trailing ribbon regions bend with delayed curves. Broad foreground ribbon remains over the unpainted hidden face. Reflected unlettered mask points left. No invented hidden anatomy.

actions.idle: Float gently while the trailing ribbons and tassels sway around a quiet face.
actions.attack: Withdraw and tilt, then peek sharply left while ribbons follow through and return.
actions.hurt: Quick rightward recoil and tilted flinch, with asymmetric trailing ribbon response.
actions.defeat: Eye illumination dies, mask tips downward left, ribbons droop, and the inactive ornament sinks into a final held pose.

orientation.method: Whole unlettered mask reflected; nose points left, peek travels left after rightward anticipation. Hurt recoils right; final tilt remains leftward. No text or handed prop reversed.

review_limits: All decoded packing/timing checks passed and chronological poses inspected. Full-speed intended-size visual approval and game integration remain unverified.
